newsitem.title: USA: Possis says February sales top Q2 level.
newsitem.headline: Possis says February sales top Q2 level.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Thursday that sales in February alone exceeded operating-basis sales for the fiscal second quarter ended January 31 of $1.9 million.
In a conference call, Chief Executive Robert Dutcher said, "February sales have already exceeded total sales for all of last quarter ... It looks like the snowball is rolling pretty good here."
He said sales of the AngioJet blood clot removal system, the company's principal product, are expected to keep rising.
AngioJet was cleared for U.S. sale by the Food and Drug Administration in early December.
Possis shares were off 3/4 at 17-1/4 at midday.

On Wednesday the medical devices maker reported a fiscal second-quarter loss of $958,250 on sales of $1.9 million. It said revenues were boosted by a one-time payment of $1.75 million related to settlement of the cancellation of a supply agreement.
